title: Black ship in a thunderstorm
content: Hi. For me the dreams started with what I now call the Black Cargo Ship. Was stuck for months. The ship is on the ocean, always night. Raining thunderstorm. Waves crashing. The seem of sea water everywhere. No land ever in sight. Can walk everywhere, explore the whole 9, but always seemed empty. Doors rarely went to rooms. Opening a door was like playing Russian roulette, could be nothing, or could be another realm, place, time. Opening a door was sometimes scarier than the ship itself. Every night I would walk around trying to find out where I was. How i got there. But never really figured it. At some point I began to notice being watched or stalked. Some nights I would be okay, be able to run and hide. But at some point was caught. That lasted for weeks. This person or entity; cloaked, heinous laugh, thick voice. In the cargo hold chained me up. In the air. Just in the middle of huge hold, dangling in air, cuffs on legs and wrists. Knife cut upon upper torso. Would wake up with searing pain from where I was cut on the ship. The pain would last for months. Years would go by, and the cargo ship hasn't returned. Became "stronger" in my mind to be able to handle it. This was the start of decades of weirder dreams and locales. Has anyone else had a similar experience?
